title: 29. Execution Integrity System (EIS)
summary: Defines the GCS subsystem that verifies distributed computation was executed faithfully according to declared execution contracts using determinism classes, checkpoint-band matching, and teacher-forced spot-check protocols.
scope: Execution Contracts (model hash, adapter version hash, SGFP4 container hash, kernel manifest ID, determinism class, sampling seed, checkpoint schedule, execution profile)
Determinism Classes (Class A Reference-integer, Class B Bounded-drift, Class C Non-deterministic)
Checkpoint-Band Matching (comparison domains, FP12-width representation, epsilon exception rates)
Teacher-Forced Spot-Check Protocol (VRF-based position sampling, O(prefill) cost profile, sampling-consistency check)
Kernel registration invariants and drift monitoring
